candidates.title: Housing sales hold steady at 2.6 lakh in Jan-Sep 2026; Mumbai leads, NCR sales fall 11% led by Gurugram
candidates.description: Mumbai, led with sales of 72,804 housing units during 9M CY2026, followed by Bengaluru with 43,140 units. NCR records decline in sales by 11% yoy | Real Estate News
candidates.articleTextExcerpt: Housing sales hold steady at 2.6 lakh in Jan-Sep 2026; Mumbai leads, NCR sales fall 11% led by GurugramMumbai, led with sales of 72,804 housing units during 9M CY2026, followed by Bengaluru with 43,140 units. NCR records decline in sales by 11% yoyPublished on: Oct 5, 2026, 14:51:15 ISTBy Vandana RamnaniPrefer HTon GoogleShare viaCopy link Housing sales across the eight key markets remained largely stable at nearly 2.6 lakh units between January and September 2026, with Mumbai leading with 72,804 units, followed by Bengaluru and Pune. NCR was the only market to record a decline, with sales falling 11%, led by Gurugram, even as the other seven markets grew 2%. The bigger structural shift was at the premium end, with homes priced above ₹1 crore accounting for 56% of sales, up sharply from 16% in 2018, signalling a sustained shift towards higher-value housing.Housing sales across the eight key markets remained largely stable at nearly 2.6 lakh units between January and September 2026, with Mumbai leading with 72,804 units, followed by Bengaluru and Pune (Photo for representational purposes only) (Unsplash)A total of 279,899 units were launched during 9M CY2026, registering 4% growth.

article.articleTextExcerpt: A monorail runs on a single elevated beam rather than a conventional two-rail track. That makes it a compact, fully elevated mode, useful on dense urban corridors where road space is tight. In India the flagship is the Mumbai Monorail, the country’s first and so far only system. This page covers monorail in India: how the technology works, where it runs, and the latest developments. A monorail vehicle straddles or hangs from a single guideway beam, usually on rubber tyres. The result is a small footprint, a tight turning radius and a quiet ride. Most modern systems, Mumbai’s included, use the straddle-beam design, where the train sits astride a slim concrete beam. On capacity it sits below metro. It works well as a feeder or on medium-demand corridors, but it cannot match a metro’s throughput, which is why cities weigh it carefully against light metro and Metrolite. The Mumbai Monorail is India’s first and only monorail, running 19.54 km between Chembur and Sant Gadge Maharaj Chowk (Jacob Circle) under the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA), serving eastern and central Mumbai neighbourhoods that the metro and suburban rail do not reach directly. It has brought forward that the proportion of households consuming iodised salt has dropped from 94.9 per cent in the last survey to 88.7 per cent. Iodised salt is a critical source of iodine, a trace mineral required for the production of thyroid hormones that regulate growth, metabolism and development. Public health experts warn that the decline in usage could reverse decades of progress made under India’s Universal Salt Iodisation (USI) programme, which was introduced to combat iodine deficiency disorders. The growing popularity of sendha namak (rock salt) and other speciality variants has contributed to the decline. “While these alternatives are often marketed as ‘natural’ or ‘pure’ but they lack adequate iodine content. Sendha namak may be used occasionally, but relying on it exclusively for daily cooking deprives the body of essential iodine,” said Dipti, a nutritionist. Another historic and joyous milestone for Project Cheetah! 🐆❤️ KJP21, a 32-month-old Indian-born female cheetah, has given birth to five healthy cubs in Kuno National Park today. The commission found serious delays in key tenders for replacing damaged pipelines and laying new ones, attributing them to red tape and administrative laxity in the Indore Municipal Corporation (IMC). article.title: Max Estates achieves Dual 5-Star
article.description: Max Estates earns a Dual 5-Star GRESB 2026 rating, retaining a perfect 100/100 Development score for the second consecutive year.
article.articleTextExcerpt: Max Estates Limited (Max Estates), a leading real estate developer in the NCR, has achieved a Dual 5-Star Rating in the 2026 GRESB Real Estate Assessment for the second consecutive year, retaining its perfect score of 100/100 in the Development category and improving its score to 93.5/100 in Standing Investments. The company ranked No. 1 among its GRESB-defined peer group of six listed residential real estate entities in India in the Development category. The GRESB Real Estate Assessment is an investor-driven global benchmark that evaluates the environmental, social and governance (ESG) performance of real estate companies and portfolios. postedNews.title: Housing sales hold steady at 2.6 lakh in Jan-Sep 2026; Mumbai leads, NCR sales fall 11% led by Gurugram
postedNews.description: Mumbai, led with sales of 72,804 housing units during 9M CY2026, followed by Bengaluru with 43,140 units. NCR records decline in sales by 11% yoy | Real Estate News
postedNews.articleTextExcerpt: Housing sales hold steady at 2.6 lakh in Jan-Sep 2026; Mumbai leads, NCR sales fall 11% led by GurugramMumbai, led with sales of 72,804 housing units during 9M CY2026, followed by Bengaluru with 43,140 units. NCR records decline in sales by 11% yoyPublished on: Oct 5, 2026, 14:51:15 ISTBy Vandana RamnaniPrefer HTon GoogleShare viaCopy link Housing sales across the eight key markets remained largely stable at nearly 2.6 lakh units between January and September 2026, with Mumbai leading with 72,804 units, followed by Bengaluru and Pune. NCR was the only market to record a decline, with sales falling 11%, led by Gurugram, even as the other seven markets grew 2%. The bigger structural shift was at the premium end, with homes priced above ₹1 crore accounting for 56% of sales, up sharply from 16% in 2018, signalling a sustained shift towards higher-value housing.Housing sales across the eight key markets remained largely stable at nearly 2.6 lakh units between January and September 2026, with Mumbai leading with 72,804 units, followed by Bengaluru and Pune (Photo for representational purposes only) (Unsplash)A total of 279,899 units were launched during 9M CY2026, registering 4% growth.

postedNews.articleTextExcerpt: Gaurs Group sells 1,088 flats for Rs 1,800 cr in new housing project in NCRSECTIONSGaurs Group sells 1,088 flats for Rs 1,800 cr in new housing project in NCRPTILast Updated: Oct 05, 2026, 05:32:00 PM ISTRate StoryFollow usFont SizeAbcSmallAbcMediumAbcLargeSavePrintSynopsisGaurs Group has successfully sold 1,088 apartments in its new project located on Yamuna Expressway.
